name: Rambler Gail

intro.text: Seventy-nine miles of Wolds Way and I've only fallen in one dew pond. Fancy a battle while I wring my socks out?

win: Fair enough. I'll walk it off. Literally, it's another forty miles.
after: The acorn waymarks are on every gatepost. Keep the acorn on your left and the sheep on your right.
